title: Cannabis Horoscope: Strains and Products by Zodiac Sign
h1: Your Cannabis Horoscope: A Strain Profile and Format for Every Sign

body:
A cannabis horoscope is a playful way to browse: start with your sign’s personality and land on a strain profile and a format that suit it. The stars won’t predict how cannabis feels for you (your dose, the product’s chemistry and your setting do that), but they make a fun lens for exploring the menu. Below is a profile and a format for every sign, with classic strains named as examples only.

## How to read your cannabis horoscope

Think of this as a conversation starter, not a set of instructions. Each sign gets three things: a quick personality sketch, a classic strain that fits the mood, and a format that suits the sign’s style.

A few ground rules keep it useful:

- **Strain names are examples.** The same name can carry different genetics from one grower to the next, and selection varies by store and changes often. Your store’s menu shows what’s available today.
- **Reported effects are anecdotal.** Descriptions like “uplifting” or “mellow” come from what people tend to say, not from controlled studies.
- **Your sign doesn’t set your dose.** Start low with anything new, especially edibles.
- **It’s all for adults.** Cannabis is for people 21 and older, or 18 and older with a medical marijuana card.

## Fire signs: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius

These three run on energy and enthusiasm. Upbeat, bright-smelling profiles suit them, along with grab-and-go formats that need no setup. Grab-and-go doesn’t mean public, though: Michigan doesn’t allow consuming cannabis in public places, so enjoy it at home or on private property where it’s welcome.

### Aries (March 21 to April 19)

Bold, competitive and first in line for anything new, Aries wants to get going. A strain for Aries should match that pace: Sour Diesel, a classic with a sharp fuel-and-citrus aroma, has a reputation as an energetic daytime pick. Format: a single pre-roll, ready when you are, with no gear to fuss over. Pair it with a new playlist and a backyard game with friends.

### Leo (July 23 to August 22)

Warm, generous and happiest at the center of the party, Leo is a natural host. Wedding Cake, a sweet, vanilla-scented hybrid, fits a celebratory mood. Format: a multi-pack of pre-rolls to share with friends who are 21 and older. Seasoned Leos may reach for an infused pre-roll, which runs stronger, so pace it. Pair it with a dinner party where you get to tell the best stories.

### Sagittarius (November 22 to December 21)

Curious, restless and always planning the next trip, Sagittarius likes big ideas and open roads. Jack Herer, a piney, spicy classic often described as clear-headed, suits that wandering mind. Format: a compact vape pen for evenings at a rented cabin where the host permits cannabis. Pair it with a planning session for your next trip. One firm travel note: don’t travel across state lines with cannabis.

## Earth signs: Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn

Earth signs are grounded, practical and fond of things that work. Indulgent edibles, precise capsules and tinctures, and dependable balanced hybrids all fit here.

### Taurus (April 20 to May 20)

Taurus loves comfort, good food and a routine that doesn’t change much. Granddaddy Purple, with its grape-and-berry aroma, has a mellow, indulgent reputation. Format: a chocolate or a baked edible, enjoyed slowly on the couch with a long dinner behind you and no plans ahead. Edibles start late, so give it up to two hours before deciding you need more. Our [Taurus shopping guide](/blog/shopping-cannabis-zodiac-taurus-picks/) goes deeper.

### Virgo (August 23 to September 22)

Organized and detail-minded, Virgo likes to know exactly what’s in the glass. Harlequin, a classic known for carrying about as much CBD as THC, or more, has a reputation as a gentler, more measured experience. Format: capsules or a tincture with a marked dropper, so every serving is a number you can write down. Pair it with a crossword, a tidy shelf and a notebook for how it felt.

### Capricorn (December 22 to January 19)

Disciplined, ambitious and the last one to leave the office, Capricorn wants something reliable for the end of the week. OG Kush, an earthy, piney classic that turns up in the family tree of many newer strains, is one of the best-known names in cannabis. Format: a low-dose edible or a measured tincture on a night with nothing early the next morning. Pair it with a Friday evening and your phone on do-not-disturb.

## Air signs: Gemini, Libra and Aquarius

Air signs live in conversation and ideas. Social, creative profiles and flexible formats that bend with a changing plan suit them best.

### Gemini (May 21 to June 20)

Quick-witted, curious and easily bored, Gemini wants options. Blue Dream, a berry-sweet hybrid with a versatile reputation, fits a sign that changes its mind twice before dinner. Format: a variety pack of low-dose gummies, or a vape pen for small, adjustable amounts. Pair it with a game night where the conversation matters more than the score.

### Libra (September 23 to October 22)

Libra seeks balance, beauty and good company. White Widow, a 1990s classic often described as balanced, suits a sign that hates extremes. Format: 1:1 THC-to-CBD gummies or a low-dose drink, served on a nice tray, because Libra cares how things look. Pair it with a pretty snack board and a friend or two.

### Aquarius (January 20 to February 18)

Independent and original, Aquarius likes what’s unusual. Durban Poison, a sativa classic with a sweet, licorice-like aroma, stands apart from the usual crowd. Format: a live resin vape, whose terpene-forward flavor rewards a curious palate. Pair it with a documentary or a late-night brainstorm.

## Water signs: Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces

Water signs feel things deeply and recharge in private. Calm, CBD-forward or deeply relaxing profiles and quiet, self-care formats fit this trio. And if you’re reading this in late October, it’s Scorpio season.

### Cancer (June 21 to July 22)

Home-loving and nurturing, Cancer would rather host a cozy night in than go out. Northern Lights, a sweet, earthy classic indica, suits a blanket-and-movie evening. Format: a low-dose edible at home, paired with a cannabis bath soak or lotion for a slow night, comfort food and a movie you’ve seen a dozen times.

### Scorpio (October 23 to November 21)

Intense, private and all-in on whatever it does, Scorpio likes depth. Bubba Kush, with its coffee-and-cocoa aroma and heavy reputation, fits a solo evening. Format: flower in a quiet setting. Experienced Scorpios may try rosin, a solventless concentrate, in very small amounts. Pair it with a mystery novel or a moody album, alone.

### Pisces (February 19 to March 20)

Dreamy, artistic and tuned in to everyone’s feelings, Pisces needs time to drift. ACDC, a classic that tests far higher in CBD than THC, is known for producing little to no high. Format: a CBD tincture or a topical, with music and a sketchbook nearby. Pair it with a warm bath and nowhere to be.

## Twelve quick cards: weed by zodiac sign

Dates can shift by a day from year to year. Strains are classic examples, not a list of what’s in stock.

| Aries | Mar 21 to Apr 19 | Bold, energetic | Sour Diesel | Single pre-roll |
| Taurus | Apr 20 to May 20 | Comfort-loving | Granddaddy Purple | Chocolate or baked edible |
| Gemini | May 21 to Jun 20 | Curious, changeable | Blue Dream | Gummy variety pack or vape |
| Cancer | Jun 21 to Jul 22 | Nurturing, homebody | Northern Lights | Low-dose edible, bath soak |
| Leo | Jul 23 to Aug 22 | Warm, generous host | Wedding Cake | Pre-roll multi-pack |
| Virgo | Aug 23 to Sep 22 | Precise, organized | Harlequin | Capsules or tincture |

## What actually predicts your experience

Here’s the useful core of any cannabis astrology: the stars don’t decide how a product feels. These do.

- **THC and CBD per serving.** THC drives intensity. A 1:1 product isn’t automatically mild; check the THC number on its own.
- **Terpenes.** These aroma compounds give a strain its scent, and many people find they prefer certain ones. Evidence that a given terpene changes how you feel is still limited. Our [guide to terpenes](/blog/what-are-cannabis-terpenes/) explains the common ones.
- **The label versus the plant.** A 2021 genetic study found that strains sold as indica or sativa often can’t be told apart at the DNA level, so read those labels loosely. Our [indica vs. sativa explainer](/blog/indica-vs-sativa/) covers why.
- **Dose and format.** Inhaled cannabis acts within minutes; edibles and capsules start late and last for hours.
- **Setting and mood.** Where you are, who you’re with and how you feel going in matter more than you might think.
- **Your tolerance.** What feels gentle to a regular can be a lot for a newcomer.

Want to test your horoscope? Try your sign’s format at a low dose and jot down how it felt. Another night, try a neighboring sign’s pick. Your notes will tell you more than your birthday ever could.

If you like this kind of matchmaking, our [cannabis mood match](/blog/cannabis-mood-match/) sorts shoppers by personality type instead of birthday.

## Turning your sign into a shopping list on the High Society menu

Ready to put your horoscope to work? Here’s an easy way to do it:

1. Open your store’s menu from our [shop page](/shop/) and look for your sign’s format, whether that’s pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures or topicals (categories vary by store).
2. Use the strain name as a starting point, then compare THC and CBD amounts. If your example isn’t on the menu, look for a similar aroma or profile.
3. Order ahead for in-store or curbside pickup, or shop in person and ask a budtender to compare two options for you.
4. Carry a current government-issued photo ID. Adult-use shopping is for customers 21 and older, and medical patients 18 and older with a card are welcome, too.

Members of The Society, our free loyalty program, earn points on qualifying purchases; you can [join The Society here](/club-member-program/). Whatever your sign, enjoy cannabis responsibly.

faq.q: What strain matches my zodiac sign?
faq.a: For fun, start with the twelve cards above. Each sign gets a classic strain example and a format that suits its style, such as Sour Diesel and a single pre-roll for Aries. Use the name as a starting point. Selection changes by store, so compare THC, CBD and aroma on your store’s menu and pick the closest match.

Not as science. No research links your birth date to how cannabis affects you; dose, the THC and CBD in the product, terpenes, your tolerance and your setting do that. Cannabis astrology is a lighthearted way to browse and try something new. Enjoy it for the fun, and lean on the label for the decision.

faq.q: What’s a good strain for a Taurus?
faq.a: In this guide, Taurus gets Granddaddy Purple, a classic with a grape-and-berry aroma and a mellow, indulgent reputation, paired with a chocolate or baked edible. Taurus tends to love comfort and routine, so a slow evening format fits. Start low with edibles and wait up to two hours. Our Taurus shopping guide has more ideas.

faq.q: Which format suits a busy Gemini?
faq.a: Something flexible. A variety pack of low-dose gummies lets a changeable Gemini pick a flavor and an amount for the moment. A vape pen allows small, adjustable servings that act quickly. Both suit a sign that likes options. Whatever you choose, keep doses small until you know how a product affects you.
